title: A finished session triggers a follow-up: thanks, a rebook link and a review ask

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: nothing runs after ends_at. Calendly Workflows and every practitioner tool send a follow-up, and Frequency already has the parts Calendly lacks: the CRM timeline (recordSpaceMemberActivity), reviews, Journeys and the coach email caps. Fix: a booking_follow_up outbox job at ends_at plus a delay, owner-editable copy, inside the existing email caps, and a 'book again' link that opens the same service.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
